name: temka-launcher

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never

description: TemkaLauncher — единый лаунчер миров Temka (TemkaWorld и Fantazia RP)
author: Temka Studio
